crypto_headlines.title: Fed holds rates at 3.75% to 4.00%
crypto_headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve held rates steady on Oct. 28 in a 10-2 vote, with Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack favoring a 25-basis-point hike, citing strong activity and still-elevated inflation.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as $356M gets liquidated
crypto_headlines.summary: Over $356M in crypto positions were liquidated in 24 hours as Bitcoin fell below $80,000, with longs taking $207.7M of the hit.

crypto_headlines.title: BTC ETFs add $137M, ETH ETFs shed $21.4M
crypto_headlines.summary: Per SoSoValue, US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $137M on Oct. 28, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $136M, while spot Ethereum ETFs saw $21.41M in net outflows.

crypto_headlines.title: NYSE parent ICE plans US perps built on Hyperliquid
crypto_headlines.summary: ICE is taking a stake in trade.xyz and plans a US-regulated perpetual futures market built on Hyperliquid.

crypto_headlines.title: Ripple projects about $900M revenue run-rate
crypto_headlines.summary: Ripple projects a roughly $900M annualized revenue run-rate by the end of 2026 as RLUSD reaches a $2.6B market cap and Ripple Payments nears $150B in lifetime volume.

crypto_headlines.title: Lagarde to step down as ECB president
crypto_headlines.summary: Christine Lagarde will step down as president of the European Central Bank on Feb. 7, 2027.

doginal_news.title: DDMIAMI 2026 is 40 days out
doginal_news.summary: Doginal Dogs says DDMIAMI 2026 is 40 days away and rooms at the Arlo Wynwood are limited.

doginal_news.title: Five AGS 10 cards sell for $4,120 on eBay
doginal_news.summary: And says five AGS Gem Mint 10 DDLTCG cards sold on eBay for $4,120 total, all for kids: Wiggles $1,050, Helios $1,000, Turbo $780, Renza $780 and Boogie $510.

doginal_news.title: Pop Report Galaxy maps graded slabs
doginal_news.summary: And introduced Pop Report Galaxy, featuring every real AGS-graded Doginal Dogs Legends slab he could find, 47 so far.

doginal_news.title: Day 3: stolen Dogs wallet still hasn't moved
doginal_news.summary: Hank reports the wallet holding the 201 swept Dogs still hasn't moved, with nothing sold or listed.

doginal_news.title: Pyth on the ICE and trade[XYZ] news
doginal_news.summary: Pyth quote-posted trade[XYZ]'s announcement that it and ICE are bringing 24/7 Hyperliquid perpetual futures to the US.

notes: Still no official @doginaldogs statement on the marketplace listing exploit; its account posted community reposts in the last 24 hours.
